title: RBAC v2 SSO + Audit: Escalation Templates, Investigations, and Support Tooling
creator: Aisha Malhotra
description: Create a pragmatic, operator-friendly set of investigation templates, escalation playbooks, and support macros for RBAC v2, SSO/SAML sign-in failures, and audit-log queries. The goal is to reduce mean time to resolution for admin/control-plane incidents and to standardize messaging for customer-facing support. This ticket bundles: (1) runbook steps for live incidents, (2) triage checklist for audit anomalies, (3) a library of support macros (Confluence + Zendesk style) and CLI/Grafana query snippets, and (4) a short training doc for oncall rotations.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook drafted and reviewed by Security and SRE teams
At least 6 support macros added to the Support macros repository with examples
Prometheus/Grafana or Elastic queries included for the three most common audit scenarios: unauthorized access attempts, privilege escalation, and admin API misuse
One tabletop exercise scheduled and notes captured
Security review completed and sign-off recorded

runbook_steps: Identify symptoms: customer complaint, automated alert, or console anomaly (examples: sudden spike in 403s on admin routes; large number of role changes).
Gather context: collect request IDs, user email/ID, affected resources, time window, and relevant model or deployment IDs.
Query audit logs (read-only): run the standard timebox queries (examples below). Save results to /tmp/rbac-investigation-<timestamp>.json and attach to incident.
Check SAML/IdP status: confirm IdP health using status.redwood-idp.com and check recent SAML metadata rotations. If multiple customers report sign-in issues, coordinate with IdP contacts.
Validate RBAC policy diffs: compare live policies against the last-known committed policy bundle (git tag: policies/rbac-v2@stable). Use the rbac-policy-diff tool.
Containment: if active misuse is detected (admin token misuse, privilege escalation), rotate tokens and enable 'admin-readonly' global mode as temporary mitigation. Communicate via incident channel.
Remediation: roll back policy drift or apply corrective policy with feature-flagged rollout. Document the change and include link to PR.
Post-incident: run automated regression evaluation against synthetic prompts to ensure no customer-facing breakages; file a postmortem if outage > 30 minutes or customer impact high.
support_macros: MACRO: SSO-LOGIN-FAILURE-BASIC - Copyable response for customers experiencing SAML assertion failures. Includes required logs to collect (timestamp, idp_request_id, assertion_audience) and guidance to check IdP certificate expiry.

MACRO: RBAC-DIFF-REQUEST - Template asking for the user email, intended role change, and whether IAM was performed via Console/CLI/API. Includes pre-filled instructions for how to export policy bundle via console.
MACRO: AUDIT-ESCALATE-TEMPLATE - Internal escalation message for high-risk audit anomalies. Includes severity checklist and recommended immediate mitigation (token rotation, temporary role lock).
MACRO: DATA-DISCLOSURE-CHECK - Short form to confirm that logs attached to customer support tickets do not contain PII or model data; required before external sharing.
MACRO: TEMP-ADMIN-LOCK - Steps to temporarily remove admin privileges on a tenant and note to create a verification ticket for re-enablement. Includes links to console workflow.
MACRO: SAML-METADATA-ROTATION-GUIDE - Walkthrough sent to customer IdP admins for rotating certificates and re-syncing metadata.
query_snippets: Audit query - failed admin auths (Elastic): GET /_search?q=event.type:auth AND outcome:failure AND resource.role:admin AND @timestamp:[now-1h TO now]
Audit query - privilege escalation (Prometheus labels): sum(rate(rbac_policy_changes_total{change_type=\"role_grant\"}[5m])) by (initiator_email)
SAML errors - last 24h (Elastic): event.subtype:saml AND message:Exception AND @timestamp:[now-24h TO now] | sort -@timestamp
KV cache mismatch - quick check: curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" https://console.redwood.ai/internal/kv/probes/rbac-cache-status
